parts.label: a
parts.ask: A particle \(P\) of mass 5 kg is pulled along a rough horizontal plane by a horizontal force of 28 N. The only resistance is friction, \(F\) N, acting the opposite way (Figure 1). Find the magnitude of the normal reaction of the plane on \(P\).

steps.why: Only \(R\) and the weight act vertically, and they balance.

parts.label: b
parts.ask: The particle accelerates along the plane at \(1.4\) m s⁻². Find the value of \(F\).
parts.method: Newton's second law along the plane

steps.why: Friction acts against the 28 N pull.

parts.label: c
parts.ask: The coefficient of friction between \(P\) and the plane is \(\mu\). Find \(\mu\) to 2 significant figures.

steps.why: \(P\) is sliding, so friction is at its maximum.
\(g = 9.8\) is to 2 s.f., so give 2 s.f.
